title: Frontiers: The Effect of an Ad Ban on Retailer Sales: Insights from a Natural Experiment
eligible_reason: Single adoption date and single treated group: one state's grocery-advertising ban in force from 2021-03-01 to 2021-03-21 (adban = 1 for stores in the treated state during those dates), compared with stores in one control state. All regressions (Tables 4, 5, 7) also include seven time-varying county/store controls (incidence, delta_incidence, vaccination_rate_dose1/2, mobility_change, unemployment, rain) and a post_treatment_state indicator; Table 6 is a state-week aggregate with state and year-month FE. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule and the no-controls rule.
design_notes: Store-day panel (table_4.csv etc.), 2021-01-04 to 2021-06-28, one treated state and one control state of a German grocery retailer; feols(Y ~ adban + controls | store + date) via adban::model_wrapper (adban/R/models.R lines 4-20) with config.yaml defining treatment, controls and FE. Table 3 is a bootstrap 2x2 DiD of means. Table 6: state x week consumer-panel (GfK) data with state and year_month FE and adban_promo interaction. Table 7 interacts adban with high_mobility / high_incidence / high_vaccination.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One treated state, ad ban 1-21 March 2021.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; time-varying controls; post_treatment_state regressor
specs.treatment_definition: 1 if the store is in the treated state and the date falls in the ad-ban window (2021-03-01 to 2021-03-21)
specs.controls: incidence delta_incidence vaccination_rate_dose1 vaccination_rate_dose2 mobility_change unemployment rain post_treatment_state
specs.cluster: fixest default (clustered by first FE, store)
specs.notes: Tables 5 and 7 are the same model on loyalty-card splits and COVID interactions; Table 6 uses model_wrapper_gfk with state + year_month FE on consumer-panel data.

data_files: data/table_2_3.csv (1.0 MB; outcomes shuffled within DiD cells)
data/table_4.csv, table_5.csv, table_7.csv (1.2-1.4 MB; synthetic outcomes that reproduce the coefficients)
data_files_note: README: outcomes for Tables 2-3 are shuffled across stores and dates within the four DiD cells; for Tables 4-7 'we generate synthetic outcome data that produces the same coefficients'. Independent variables are original. Under PROTOCOL 5b this is synthetic/disguised data.
software_notes: R 4.3.3 with a bundled 'adban' package; fixest::feols, data.table, modelsummary.
priority_note: Single-date DiD with controls; synthetic outcome data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. regressions.txt contains only the two generic feols wrappers; the actual specification lives in config.yaml.
